reason: B is the better proposal because it introduces a distinct, testable particle-scale interfacial intervention applicable throughout the composite, whereas A largely repeats the cited CPF study and only modifies a shallow surface layer. B remains weakened by absent supporting evidence, unspecified coating/sintering parameters, and the risk that Cu–Ni alloying will reduce thermal conductivity, but it offers greater novelty and a clearer comparison to the near-perfect-contact vapor-coated baseline.
